Margin of safety is in price space. Your method allows you to back out the return of every stock in the SP500, without requiring a discount rate. Then you can look at companies with the highest return to invest in. That puts you in the right place to best invest today. You can reject stocks under 15% and go for the stocks offering 25% plus. Buying at half the intrinsic value almost never happens and waiting in cash means you are missing out on return and incurring an opportunity cost. Far better to determine return and then look at metrics that influence the probability of achieving that return. Also, you use x2 the growth rate for fair value PE. Note the historic median of SP500 PE to growth is  1.5, so you should really use this as x2 multiple is a third too optiistic.
